about: Generalisation design G35 (train), in dev.json format. Tier 4 = a mechanism: two printed links joined by a print-in-place pivot, graded by swept-rotation interference, stop angles, printed clearances and a cable envelope through the bend, against reference models. No bought-in part is placed except a stand-in cable. Two bodies in one print, no supports. L1 ids match requirements.md next to this file, which holds the L2/L3 tree, reference models, assumptions and traceability. Numbers that are not in the request words (link length band, tolerance bands, play limits) come from requirements.md and are provisional until the owner confirms them. Never put any of these numbers in agent logic: they belong in the request text and in generalize/parts/*/part.json.

methods.inspection: read from the design or mesh (counts, sizes, positions, relations)
methods.analysis: computed by Python (swept rotation, interference and clearance against reference models, free travel, hand calculations)
methods.demonstration: a stand-in object is placed in the design (fits, rests, does not slide)
methods.test: a probe is applied (pass the cable through the bend, swing the link to its stops)

requests.title: Cable chain link pair
requests.request: Two links of a cable chain for a 6.5 mm cable, printed in place with 0.35 mm clearance on the pivot. Each link has an inner section 12 x 10 mm (12 mm along the pivot axis, 10 mm across the bend plane) and the pair bends 30 degrees either way about a vertical pivot pin before a stop. Each link is 20 to 40 mm long. The two links are separate bodies in one print and must not touch each other. The pivot pin is at least 3.0 mm in diameter and its head overlaps the bore by at least 0.4 mm per side; sideways play is at most 0.8 mm and axial play at most 1.2 mm. Print flat without supports.
requests.request_verbatim: Two links of a cable chain for a 6.5 mm cable, printed in place with 0.35 mm clearance on the pivot. Each link has an inner section 12 x 10 mm and bends 30 degrees either way before a stop. Print flat without supports.
requests.request_notes: Added to the owner's words, all from requirements.md section 3: the links bend in the plane they are printed in (A3, 'print flat' with a vertical pivot pin); 12 mm is along the pivot axis and 10 mm across the bend plane (A2, FD2); link length 20 to 40 mm (A5); two separate bodies that do not touch (A4); the cable is a solid 6.5 mm cylinder (A1). Audit additions: pin size, head overlap and play limits (A7, A11, L2.3.3, L2.3.4).

l1.text: The design shall deliver two separate links in one print, each one connected body, not fused to each other, and shall declare the pivot axis, the straight pose and the print orientation.
Each link shall have a straight inner section 12 mm along the pivot axis by 10 mm across the bend plane, at least 20 mm long, through which a 6.5 mm cable passes with at least 0.5 mm clearance.

The two links shall be joined by a pivot pin held in a bore with 0.35 mm clearance all round and 0.35 mm clearance axially, so the pin (at least 3.0 mm in diameter, with a head overlapping the bore by at least 0.4 mm per side) cannot come out, and the joint shall have no more than 0.8 mm of sideways play and no more than 1.2 mm of axial play.
The pair shall bend freely from 30 degrees one way to 30 degrees the other with no contact between the links and at least 0.30 mm between them.
A stop shall block the bend at 30 degrees either way, within one degree, on both sides.
A 6.5 mm cable passing through both inner sections shall clear both links by at least 0.2 mm at every bend angle from 30 degrees one way to 30 degrees the other.
Each link shall be 20 to 40 mm long, no wider than 20 mm across the bend plane and no taller than 25 mm along the pivot axis, with every wall at least 1.6 mm thick.
Both links shall print flat in one go on an FDM printer without supports, with the pivot axis vertical.
The design shall be delivered as an STL of the pair, the OpenSCAD source, the declared layout and the agent's own clearance report, and that report shall agree with an independent measurement.

beyond_library: a print-in-place joint: a pin fused to one link, a bore and a head on the other, with gaps of 0.35 mm, in two bodies that must not touch
swept rotation about an axis: interference of one body against the other over an angle range, and the angle at which a stop first interferes
stop geometry derived from an angle limit and the link's width
a cable envelope bent through the joint, kept clear of both bodies
a print orientation analysis with an exemption for printed clearance gaps
relief cuts in plates and walls so two bodies share a pivot region without touching
